parsed.why: Enforced criminalisation reaches gender presentation directly: trans women arrested for clothing and given maximum five-year terms, security-force arbitrary detention and beatings, police extortion, no functioning recourse or legal aid. Organised state targeting of the gender-nonconforming dominates everything.

No criminalisation, no trans-specific visitor restriction or violence documented; EU-court-backed transcription rulings show institutions working for trans people. Offsets hostile prime-minister rhetoric, right-wing hostility and local Pride bans, which are climate, not traveller exposure.

Documented third-gender social acceptance is strong; sodomy and 'impersonation' statutes are latent, not enforced. Thin recourse, a 2021 activist murder and rising fundamentalism hold it a step below the acceptance-with-protections tier rather than a risk tier.

National restroom ban by birth sex is a universal-exposure measure with no working remedy; hate crimes rising with trans women most affected; police torture of a trans woman. Conviction after 20 years and name-change rights mitigate, but tier-1 facility exclusion keeps Elevated band.

No criminalisation, no facility rules, open borders, occasional violence without pattern, positive climate (openly gay head of state, constitutional SO protection). No gender-identity hate-crime coverage and no LGR are resident gaps, not visitor exposures; silent thin record is modest.
